# KappaHat {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
KappaHat()
```
Chart choice for spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs): the statistic $\hat{\kappa} = \hat{p}_2 - \hat{p}_3$, the difference of the relative frequencies of the second and third SOP type.
 


:::
